feature: Hardware (USB wedge) barcode scan to cart
user_story: As a cashier, I want to scan a product barcode with the USB scanner so the item drops into the cart instantly without touching the keyboard.
expected_behaviour: A connected USB 1D/2D scanner (PM-BS007D) types the code + Enter; a global keydown listener detects scanner-speed bursts (<50ms) and on Enter looks up barcode OR quick_code in the local DB and adds the item; unknown code shows a toast, not a dead-end.

user_story: As a cashier, I want to type or scan a code (with optional N* quantity) so I can add items when a scan is ambiguous.
expected_behaviour: Scan input accepts barcode/quick_code/name; supports N*code to add N units; resolves in-memory then DB; not-found shows toast.

user_story: As an admin, I want to scan a barcode with the device camera while registering a product so I can assign it without typing.
expected_behaviour: Opens camera; on a supported browser decodes via BarcodeDetector and fills the field; on an UNSUPPORTED browser it must clearly say so and point to the USB scanner / manual entry — not silently do nothing.
test_method: Scanner.test.tsx (asserts notice renders when BarcodeDetector absent)
error_detail: On Safari/Firefox (no BarcodeDetector) the viewfinder showed but never scanned and gave no message — a silent dead state.
fix_summary: Show a clear 'use Chrome/Edge, a USB scanner, or type the code' notice in the viewfinder when BarcodeDetector is unavailable, instead of a silent console.warn; updated the test that previously asserted the silent behaviour.
retest_result: pass — notice renders; full suite 195 green

user_story: As a cashier, I want the receipt to print on the XP-365B thermal printer with one tap so I can hand it over and serve the next customer.
expected_behaviour: render() produces ESC/POS bytes from the shared receipt model; bytes are written over Web Serial; a previously-granted printer reconnects silently on load so there is no per-sale prompt.

user_story: As a cashier on a machine without a serial printer, I want printing to still work so the queue never stalls.
expected_behaviour: If Web Serial is unsupported, the printer is not yet picked, or a real error occurs, printing falls back to the OS print dialog automatically; canceling the picker aborts cleanly (no double prompt).
test_method: Code trace of handleSmartPrint routing + isUserCancellation unit test

user_story: As an admin, I want to connect the thermal printer once and print a test slip so I know it works before a shift.
expected_behaviour: Settings modal detects Web Serial, connects (one-time native picker), persists the port, lets the admin set paper width (58/80mm), baud, and cash-drawer pin, and prints a test receipt; unsupported browsers get a clear notice.
test_method: Code trace + transport unit tests + next build

user_story: As a cashier/manager, I want to reprint an old receipt so I can re-issue a bill.
expected_behaviour: Invoice detail modal renders the same receipt and reprints via the shared print path.

user_story: As a cashier, I want the on-screen receipt preview to match what actually prints so I trust what I hand over.
expected_behaviour: Preview HTML, system-print HTML, and thermal ESC/POS all derive rows/values/labels from one buildReceiptModel — content cannot drift.

user_story: As a staff member, I want to print a product barcode label on the XP-365B so I can tag stock.
expected_behaviour: Label modal renders an EAN-13/CODE128 barcode (auto-detected) + QR via jsbarcode/qrcode and prints a 58x80mm label through the OS print dialog.

user_story: As a cashier, I want the cash drawer (PM-CD094) to pop open automatically when I complete a cash sale so I can give change without fumbling for a key.
expected_behaviour: On a cash sale, printing the receipt over Web Serial sends the ESC/POS drawer-kick to the printer the drawer is wired to, so the drawer opens; admin can also open it on demand from settings, and choose the 2-pin/5-pin kick.
error_detail: The purchased cash drawer was NOT supported: the web app never emitted a drawer-kick command, so a cash sale could not open the drawer.
fix_summary: Added ESC/POS drawer kick via react-thermal-printer's <Cashdraw>: auto-fired on cash sales when printing over Web Serial, plus an on-demand 'Open Cash Drawer' action and a 2pin/5pin setting. NOTE: only fires on the Web Serial path; the system-print path opens the drawer via the printer driver's setting.
retest_result: pass — tests assert ESC p (0x1B 0x70) present on cash receipts/on-demand and absent otherwise; 195 green

feature: Windows touch terminal + Web Serial capability
user_story: As an operator on the POSMAX i7 Windows terminal, I want the app and direct printing to work in the installed browser.
expected_behaviour: App runs in Chrome/Edge on Windows; Web Serial is feature-detected and, when absent, the app degrades to system print rather than erroring.
